crop_top_precedence_rule: If Attribute ID 8 'crop (top)' is present in attribute_ids, garment_type is assigned as crop-top regardless of Category 0 or 1.
required_labels_policy: Each training_ready sample must contain exactly one valid label for every one of the four heads.
ambiguity_policy: Reject or route to manual_review if conflicting labels exist for the same head.
missing_label_policy: Route to manual_review or rejected if required head labels are missing.
candidate_mapping_policy: Instances relying on candidate_mapping categories or attributes must be assigned to manual_review.
source_grouping_strategy: Group by source_image_id to prevent cross-split leakage.
split_assignment_strategy: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of (str(source_image_id) + '_' + str(seed)) modulo 100.
